# Fed Dilemmas and SLR Updates

Report 165 | Published 2025-06-22 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2025-6-22/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/165.json)

Monetary constraints, Bitcoin financing and bank regulation.

The TGA funding warning, bill-issuance scenario and broad bank entry thesis received support. The report correctly separates SLR from risk-weighted capital here, but misdescribes the scope of 2020 relief. Corporate Bitcoin financing has useful maturity protections alongside severe equity and premium risks.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

### 165-C08

**Higher rates also increase fiscal interest transfers.**

| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |

| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | rate-hike-fiscal-interest-channel |
| Source blocks | 35, 40 |
| Thesis family | rate-hike-fiscal-interest-channel |

As debt refinances, a higher borrowing rate raises interest expense for unchanged principal and maturity structure. The increase is gradual and depends on issuance, inflation-linked debt and Fed remittances. It is an income channel, not a proof that the whole rate hike is stimulative.

**Direction:** See assessment; evidence is limited to the stated proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Price direction alone does not identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Deductive assessment:**

- Principal unchanged
- Debt reprices at a higher rate
- No offsetting fiscal change

Interest expense on repriced debt equals principal times rate; a higher rate raises that flow.

No independent outcome source is recorded. Any deductive assessment is identified separately.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Fiscal versus private credit:** Flow size does not identify causal dominance Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Fed projections:** Conditional policymaker forecasts Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Treasury-company NAV premiums:** Financing access and reflexive equity valuation Visual inspection: not performed.
- **HODL waves and MVRV:** Coin-age and cost-basis proxies Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Bank Treasury ratios and SLR:** Separate leverage, liquidity and risk-weighted constraints Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- Long funding reduces refinancing risk without eliminating asset-price risk.
- Always identify which regulatory denominator is being changed.

## Verification limitations

- Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
- Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
